Getting here + sitemap Escarpment Domes
Getting here + sitemap
Aerial shot of domes site
The Gallery dome is at the top of the image. The Peak to the left and the Nook in the centre just in front of the Communal dome.
It’s 150m from the drop off area by the Communal dome down to the Gallery and the track is a bit steep in places.
The Peak and the Nook are both about 30m from the drop off area. If you have limited mobility we suggest the Nook as it’s the easiest to walk to.
Getting to the carpark
Don’t click on our location on Google maps it gives you incorrect directions. Please use the address you’ll be given with your arrival details.
Look out for these 2 signs as you drive up the driveway.
On the fence at the start of the drive
On the gate at the halfway point
When you get to the address you’ll see the first sign. Start driving up the 800m long single lane shared driveway (20kph please) and you’ll pass a house, go through a wooden gate that is often left open, drive down and back up to a large shed and a gate with the second sign on it. Great you’re halfway down the drive. Please go through the gate and close it behind you. The carpark is a bit further on you can’t miss it from there.
